title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_distopia_mexicana_by_lorenzo_meyer_r5yi0 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_distopia_mexicana_by_lorenzo_meyer_r5yi0' is identified as malicious software. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, with potential unauthorized access to all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets from a different, uncompromised system due to possible persistent control by attackers.
